notes.title: Great news! New update available!
notes.content:
New buildings and army levels will help you crush your foes and achieve victory
- New building - the Forge: only the most skillful and daring spellsmiths can craft enchantments out of white-hot lava.
- The new spells require a high degree of mastery and grant a unique tactical advantage.
- VIP Club: become a privileged member of the club
- Lots of army levels and building upgrades

notes.title: Great news! New update available!
notes.content:
Hero skins have been added. This new gameplay mechanic is intended to assist you in crushing your enemies and reigning victorious!
- A new mode for heroes has been added: heroes can now change their skins, each of which provides them with a unique set of characteristics.
- A new tournament type has been added: the combat trial. Here guilds will compete against each other for a week for rewards and the main prize - a hero skin set.
- Invasion of Tror, King of Dwarves has been added.
- Some bugs have been fixed, and several improvements have been made to the game.

notes.title: Great news! New version available!
notes.content:
We have embodied the conflict of light and darkness in two of our new units. Meet: 
- Witch - mighty protectors of the magic of light 
- Сontemplator - assassins that hides in the shadows 
- Based on numerous requests, we’ve increased the radius of the Focus spell
- New mechanic for free restoring the army and doubling loot for rest points 
- You can now get rewards for inviting friends 
- Sometimes in battle you can get a rare dragon egg that gives incredible bonuses

notes.title: Great news! New version available!
notes.content:
The northern winds have brought with them the ill news of the Ice Golem’s invasion: 
- Assemble a guild of allies and repel the monster’s attack!
- Get some crystals as a reward for defeating the Ice Golem.
- Assist your allies in battle!
- Increase your guild’s prize fund! 

Our mages have decided to gain control over the power of the elements, and so they have prepared a surprise for you:

New unit :
- Ice Golem

New levels are also now available: 

- Watchtower
- Guardian Serpent
- Eye of Death
- Whirlwind Flinger
- Chopper
- Clockwork Hulk
- Elven Archer
- Mechanic
- Hornet
- Chain Lightning
- Whirlwind
- Rain of Fire
- Fire Nova And that’s not all! 

Other improvements: 

- Now you can recharge defensie buildings with just one tap/click 
- Bugs fixed
- Performance improved
